methodology: The 70 scores are explicit user decisions even where separate suitability was left null.
The old HTML completion metric of 2/70 reflects both score+fit; do not call the other 68 unrated.
0–2 rejects the rated original globally and must be excluded from future reviews, images and variants after exact-object identity is resolved.
3 research only, 4 pending final curation, 5 would mean user aesthetic selection only; this export has zero 5.
Never convert a 4 into a 5 because of subject suitability or image quality inferred elsewhere.
The 8 sourceIssue flags have no detailed reason and do not establish wrong image, attribution or copyright failure.
No sourceViewed checkbox was ticked; this is absence of an explicit confirmation, not proof user did not see artworks.
No user photo/artist/physical attribution was reverified and no publication master or permissions have been secured.
Previous existing numeric-five corpus remains 109 known ID records, not automatically unique physical paintings.
No rights-holder outreach and no paid licences. No live app changes.
